title: Kokedama Workshop
seo_title: Kokedama Workshop in Bolivar, MO on Nov 14, 2026
description: This is a hands-on workshop where you make your own Kokedama, with guided instructions. The $25 per person fee covers a starter plant, moss, soil, twine, all supplies, and a care card, and there are 12 spots for this first workshop. It takes place on November 14, 2026 (time TBD) at 115 N Main Ave in Bolivar, MO.
